findings.title: Published OpenAPI lacks operation and parameter descriptions
findings.evidence: Live GET /api/v3-preview/openapi.json has 67 operations and 141 operation parameters (208 items). 206 description fields are absent; two descriptions are longer than 15 characters. GET /api/v3-preview/pages/ has summary List pages but no description; query parameters search, ancestor_of, child_of, locale, order, etc. have schema types/defaults but no usage explanations. This confirms absent explanations, not the scanner claim that every description must exceed a particular length.
findings.action: Improve operation/parameter documentation in the Wagtail v3 API generator. Guide imports upstream wagtail.api.v3; changes may belong upstream. Related #538 concerns CMS-user API documentation.

findings.title: MCP catalog entry has no human-readable description
findings.evidence: Live catalog now contains five entries (archived scanner counted three). MCP entry urn:air:guide.wagtail.org:mcp:wagtail-guide has identifier, type, url, tags and publisher, but no description or displayName. Confirmed in current GitHub main.
findings.action: Add a concise name/description explaining that the MCP server searches and reads the Wagtail editor guide. Treat as discoverability improvement, not proof that registry consumers cannot find it or a mandatory schema violation.

findings.title: Mobile copy menu inherits a different page Markdown URL from cached header
findings.evidence: Parent browser review confirmed homepage mobile menu link points to /en/concepts/wagtail-api/markdown/ rather than /en/markdown/. Live fetched HTML corroborates both URLs. Current main caches header for 86400 seconds with LANGUAGE_CODE only; cached navigation includes copy_button, whose Markdown href derives from page.
findings.action: Fix shared page-dependent header caching together with existing #545. Verify mobile Markdown link matches each current page after requests to different pages in the same language.

findings.title: MCP reachability and downgrade failures caused by missing MCP-Method header
findings.evidence: Repeated scanner-style server/discover request without MCP-Method -> HTTP 400 JSON-RPC -32020 header mismatch. Same request with MCP-Method: server/discover -> HTTP 200 supportedVersions [2026-07-28], capabilities, instructions and server metadata. tools/list with matching header -> HTTP 200 actual read-only tools. Unsupported version 1900-01-01 with matching method header -> HTTP 400 -32022 and data.supported [2026-07-28], as expected. No mutating tool invoked.
findings.action: Do not change the guide MCP server based on these failures. Correct scanner headers and rerun its probes.

findings.title: Schema coverage warning counts intentionally bodyless operations
findings.evidence: Recount confirms 59/67 operations have response schemas; all eight exceptions are DELETE responses explicitly declared 204 No Content. 24/34 POST/PUT/PATCH operations have request schemas; ten exceptions are bodyless action POSTs (page publish, convert alias, workflow submit/resume/cancel; snippet publish/unpublish and workflow submit/resume/cancel). Scanner assumes every write operation and every response must have a body schema. Public read-only GET endpoints are not missing response schemas.
findings.action: Do not add fictitious payload schemas to bodyless actions or 204 responses. Fix applicability in scanner.

findings.title: Markdown retains primary content; heading comparison mishandles links and includes footer
findings.evidence: Live Markdown contains linked H2 headings Getting started, How-to guides, Concepts, Reference, with all four explanatory paragraphs and intro. HTML uses How-to versus Markdown How-to guides (linked page title). Scanner markdownHeadings returns raw [text](url) and compares directly with HTML text. It also compares every HTML heading and body block, including footer headings About this guide, Help improve this guide, Wagtail, to content-only Markdown. Its 13% heading recall/38% prose recall do not demonstrate stale primary content.
findings.action: Do not classify Markdown alternate as unusable. Fix scanner heading normalization and primary-content comparison. Optional separate review of desired footer/navigation inclusion should be a product choice.

findings.title: OpenAPI response currently has Last-Modified revalidation metadata
findings.evidence: Live response is CF-Cache-Status HIT, Age 6337, Last-Modified Sat, 14 Nov 2026 00:29:52 GMT. No Cache-Control header, but report wording that no caching headers exist is not true of this fetched response. Conditional GET was not tested.
findings.action: Keep caching policy follow-up under #498; do not claim every fetch necessarily redownloads the entire body.

findings.title: MCP registry absence not independently verified
findings.evidence: Archived scanner reports no first-party listing. No independent registry query was completed during this review.
findings.action: Keep unverified, not in confirmed site defects.
